posts.author: CleanWater
posts.body:
Engine:
RPG Maker MV
Synopsis:
Samuka, a former noble and skilled samurai from Kaganumato Island, ventures through the world indefinitely after a pub to drink out his misadventures without knowing that the future of Earth, and even the good sake of Time-Space continuum, lays at his hands.
Later, a stray dog, an orphaned martian and a madhouse escapee join his party to journey alongside him through the past and the future on this epic nonsense adventure.
Anew Fantasy
is both a parody to shabby-made RPG Maker games and homage to old classics of the 16-bit J-RPG era that have won the heart of many generations of players around the globe.
The project topic on this forum
​
Positions/Roles Needed:
Beta testers. 5 in total. Just play the game and search for bugs, misspellings, etc. Also, your personal opinion regarding the game is welcome (too hard or too easy, solid or lame game play, nice or bad story line, etc).
My Role(s)/Position(s):
Solo developer.
Skill Trade:
Is it possible to bargain both things here? I mean, if there's someone who aren't willing to play test for free, but want to exchange for some sprite edits of mine maybe?
Tags:
RPG, Comedy
